Sine, clock sync on; stored division code: 46877. Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/01 LFO Shape · Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/02 LFO Rate
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.
Values describe saved base settings before modulation. Controls use normalized 0…1 values unless a stored choice code is shown; they are not OLED percentages, hertz or milliseconds.
Microfreak/CLI/Inspect a preset preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix assignments follow the Freakout live map. Mode, LFO shape, filter type and octave labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.

Read from the connected MicroFreak's slot 122 over USB on October 25, 2026 with mise run microfreak:download --slot 122. The file is the preset header followed by the unmodified data packets the device sends, as described in the download task. It is not a MIDI Control Center .mbp file. SHA-256: 934ec8f47cc3c59850cbbed509dc4a3c745ec4b15b3afecbc2e239b4af82a6de.

On October 27, 2026, two further read-only USB downloads of saved slot 123 returned identical slot-123.bin files, matching the October 25 export and this page’s file and parameter-payload SHA-256 values. The download protocol reads saved memory without selecting the preset.
